market_question: Will Neymar play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Neymar will be 34 by the 2026 World Cup and is recovering from a severe ACL injury sustained in October 2023, with an uncertain club future after his Al-Hilal contract ends in 2025. The market-implied 78.5% probability appears overly optimistic given his age, injury track record, and Brazil's deep pool of young attacking talent; a more realistic estimate is around 55%.
evidence_points: Severe ACL injury in October 2023 requiring surgery and long rehab.
Age 34 by World Cup 2026; Brazil's alternatives (Vinicius Jr, Rodrygo, etc.) reduce reliance on him.
Uncertain club situation post-2025, risking match fitness and form for national selection.
sources_consulted: Public reports on Neymar's ACL injury and surgery timeline
Football analytics on age-related performance decline for forwards
